sections.title: General Information
sections.body:
Last updated: November 2026

We take the protection of your personal data seriously. This Privacy Policy explains what personal data is processed when you visit enaly.de or contact us, why it is processed and what rights you have.

**Data Controller**
Helena Schmidt
Enaly
Address upon request
Email: info@enaly.de

**Legal Bases for Processing**
We process personal data primarily on the following legal bases:

- Article 6(1)(b) GDPR: taking steps before entering into a contract and performing a contract.
- Article 6(1)(f) GDPR: providing a secure website, preventing misuse and responding to other enquiries.
- Article 6(1)(c) GDPR: complying with legal obligations.
- Article 6(1)(a) GDPR: where consent is required and has been given.

Section 25 of the German Telecommunications Digital Services Data Protection Act (TDDDG) also applies to storing information on your device or accessing information stored on it.

sections.title: Hosting and Security
sections.body:
**GitHub Pages**
Our website is hosted using GitHub Pages.

Provider: GitHub, Inc., 88 Colin P. Kelly Jr. Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA.

When you visit the website, GitHub processes technical connection data, including IP addresses, access times and information about the pages requested. GitHub also stores IP addresses for security purposes. We cannot access these logs, and the exact retention periods are not known to us.

**Cloudflare**
We use Cloudflare to help deliver our website securely and reliably.

Provider: Cloudflare, Inc., 101 Townsend Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA.

Cloudflare processes technical connection data, such as IP addresses, browser information and access times. This processing is based on our legitimate interest in the security and functionality of the website (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).

A data processing agreement is in place with Cloudflare. We do not have direct access to its technical logs, and the exact retention periods are not known to us.

**Processing Outside the EU/EEA**
GitHub and Cloudflare may process personal data outside the European Union (EU) or European Economic Area (EEA), particularly in the United States.

Both providers rely, where applicable, on mechanisms including the EU–US Data Privacy Framework and the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses for relevant international data transfers.

Further information about the providers' privacy practices and international data transfers:

- https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement
- https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/
- https://www.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-customer-dpa/

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body:
We do not use analytics or advertising cookies, or tracking services. Our website itself does not set any cookies.

Cloudflare does not set cookies during normal page visits. In exceptional cases, where a security check is required, Cloudflare may use the cf_clearance cookie to record that the check has been completed successfully. This storage is strictly necessary for the security of the website and is permitted under Section 25(2) TDDDG. Any associated processing of personal data is based on our legitimate interest under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.

Further information:
https://www.cloudflare.com/cookie-policy/

sections.title: Booking Form and Contact
sections.body:
**Booking Enquiries**
If you use our booking form, we process the contact details and information you provide to respond to your enquiry and, where applicable, discuss a potential booking.

Your submission is checked by a Cloudflare Worker and immediately forwarded via IONOS's email server to info@enaly.de. You will also receive an automatic acknowledgement.

Form content is not stored permanently by Cloudflare. No database, backups or logs of form content are created, and logging for the form Worker is disabled. Cloudflare may nevertheless process technical connection data as part of its general service operation.

**Cloudflare Turnstile**
We use Cloudflare Turnstile to protect our booking form against spam and automated submissions.

The service is loaded only when you interact with the form. It processes technical information such as your IP address, browser details and connection characteristics. Cloudflare may also process certain data under its own responsibility to improve the service.

This processing is based on our legitimate interest in preventing misuse (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).

Further information:
https://www.cloudflare.com/turnstile-privacy-policy/

**Email Communication**
We use the following provider to receive and store emails:

IONOS SE, Elgendorfer Str. 57, 56410 Montabaur, Germany.

We process booking enquiries and emails under Article 6(1)(b) GDPR where necessary to take steps before entering into a contract or to perform a contract. Other enquiries are processed on the basis of our legitimate interest under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.

Further information:
https://www.ionos.de/terms-gtc/datenschutzerklaerung/

**Retention Periods**
Non-binding enquiries that are not subject to statutory retention requirements are generally deleted within six months of the last contact.

Correspondence relating to ongoing booking negotiations is retained for as long as necessary to deal with the enquiry.

Business correspondence and records relevant for tax purposes are retained for the periods required by law. Otherwise, personal data is deleted once it is no longer needed and there is no legal basis for keeping it.

sections.title: Your Data Protection Rights
sections.body:
Under applicable law, you have the right to request access to your personal data and to ask for it to be corrected, erased or for its processing to be restricted.

In certain circumstances, you may request the transfer of your data.

You may withdraw any consent you have given at any time, with effect for the future. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before the withdrawal.

**Right to object:** Where we process your personal data on the basis of legitimate interests, you may object at any time on grounds relating to your particular situation. We will then generally stop processing the data unless we can demonstrate compelling legitimate grounds or the processing is necessary for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims.

You may object to the processing of your personal data for direct marketing at any time. Following such an objection, your data will no longer be processed for direct marketing purposes.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a competent data protection supervisory authority.

To exercise your rights or ask a question about data protection, please contact info@enaly.de.

sections.title: Data Security and External Links
sections.body:
Our website uses HTTPS encryption to protect data in transit.

Links to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, SoundCloud, YouTube and other external services are ordinary hyperlinks. Simply visiting our website does not transmit data to those platforms through these links. If you follow a link, the privacy practices of the relevant provider apply.

We do not embed social media posts, external music or video players, or fonts loaded from third-party servers.
